parent.description:
The parent reference. Note that if the parent also refers to its children, one or both references should be
suppressed in serialization to avoid cycles in the JSON.

title:
Base type for types that have a conceptual "parent". Note that the #parent field is likely to cause cycles and
code which traverses the hierarchy recursively should be very careful not to recurse infinitely.
See {@link ValueSpec} for ways to tune the behavior of the Obj field traversal methods.
name: WithParent
